rawReview.notes: The raw image has a translucent/opaque brown-orange backdrop and glow. Several figures approach/cross the source-cell row boundaries. Preserve the raw image unchanged; component-isolate and uniformly fit all 15 originals before any source acceptance.

sourceReview.reviewNotes: Independent visual review accepts 15 distinct row-major original poses for the specified 360 dunk arc, with consistent Piper face/skin/orange ponytail/kit/shoes, complete anatomy, no ball, and a readable turn from right-facing approach through front and back views to the right-facing finish, single release and landing. Component isolation preserves the original drawing pixels without synthesis, redraw, duplication or reorder. Dark/light proofs show no broad matte or halo remaining. The frame-9 to frame-10 release transition remains subject to separate native ball-track contact review.
